content.raw:
Gastroenterology covers the evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the stomach, intestines, liver, bile ducts and pancreas. The department at our partner hospital offers a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy, alongside dedicated care for reflux, liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease and colorectal cancer screening. MedLuxLife helps you arrange procedures, understand preparation instructions and receive your reports in a form your home doctor can use.

Treatments and services

Diagnostic endoscopy

Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy, colonoscopy and double-balloon endoscopy (enteroscopy), which can examine parts of the small intestine beyond the reach of standard scopes, for example in unexplained bleeding, iron-deficiency anaemia or suspected Crohn's disease.

Endoscopic treatment of bleeding

Band ligation, sclerotherapy, haemoclips and argon laser treatment for bleeding from the stomach or intestines.

Treatment of narrowing

Balloon dilatation and stent placement for strictures of the stomach or intestines.

Endoscopic obesity treatment

Intragastric balloon placement during upper endoscopy, which may support weight loss alongside lifestyle changes; the balloon is removed after a set period.

Reflux diagnosis and treatment

Upper endoscopy, 24-hour pH monitoring and motility studies, followed by medication, endoscopic options such as the Stretta procedure and endoscopic fundoplication (for example Plicator or Gastrofix), or surgery.

Helicobacter pylori testing

Urea breath test and stool antigen testing to diagnose H. pylori infection and guide treatment.

Colorectal cancer screening

Screening colonoscopy with polypectomy, as polyps can be found and removed during the procedure; people at higher risk receive an individual screening plan.

ERCP

Endoscopic imaging of the bile and pancreatic ducts, which also allows stone removal, stent placement to relieve blockages and biopsy.

Haemorrhoid treatment

Medication for early stages and band ligation, sclerotherapy, laser or infrared treatment during sedated colonoscopy for intermediate stages, with referral for surgery in advanced cases.

Hepatology unit

Diagnosis and long-term follow-up of chronic hepatitis B and C using liver function tests, HBV and HCV PCR, abdominal ultrasound and liver biopsy, with antiviral treatment options including interferon.

Inflammatory bowel disease

Diagnosis of ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease by colonoscopy and/or double-balloon enteroscopy, and ongoing medical treatment.

Tests and procedures

  • Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy
  • Colonoscopy
  • Double-balloon endoscopy (enteroscopy)
  • Band ligation
  • Sclerotherapy
  • Haemoclip application
  • Argon laser treatment
  • Balloon dilatation
  • Stent placement
  • Endoscopic intragastric balloon
  • Stretta procedure
  • Endoscopic fundoplication (Plicator, Gastrofix)
  • 24-hour pH monitoring
  • Motility studies
  • Urea breath test
  • Stool antigen test
  • Polypectomy
  • ERCP
  • Laser and infrared haemorrhoid treatment
  • Liver function tests
  • HBV and HCV PCR tests
  • Upper abdominal ultrasound
  • Liver biopsy

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous endoscopy or colonoscopy reports with pathology results
  • Recent liver function and hepatitis test results, if relevant

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Gastroenterology consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
